EnableUndeadCriticalHits.Name: Critical Hits by Undead
EnableUndeadCriticalHits.Hint: Enables special consequences when an undead creature critically hits with an attack. Requires a world reload.

EnableUndeadCriticalFumbles.Name: Critical Fumbles by Undead
EnableUndeadCriticalFumbles.Hint: Enables special consequences when an undead creature critically fumbles an attack. Requires a world reload.

EnableCriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Name: Critical Hits against Undead
EnableCriticalHitsAgainstUndead.Hint: Enables special consequences when an undead creature suffers a critical hit. Requires a world reload.
